rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for a person who acts without responsibility or for irresponsible conduct.

example.english: The way you’re acting is really irresponsible and will drag the whole team down.
example.traditional: 你咁樣做真係唔負責任，會累到成隊人㗎。
example.jyutping: nei5 gam3 joeng2 zou6 zan1 hai6 m4 fu6 zaak3 jam6 wui5 leoi6 dou3 sing4 deoi6 jan4 gaa3

rows.note: Use this when stressing that someone lacks a responsible attitude or sense of responsibility.

example.english: They are always late and leave early; they’re really irresponsible.
example.traditional: 佢成日遲到早退，真係冇責任心。
example.jyutping: keoi5 seng4 jat6 ci4 dou3 zou2 teoi3 zan1 hai6 mou5 zaak3 jam6 sam1
